workshop.title: 先问清，再把承诺说完整
workshop.instruction: 核对没回复的真实原因，把说话人、物主、归还条件和位置接起来。

items.label: 对方的猜测，要用回应核实
items.prompt: Why did Mei see Lina’s message late?
items.answer: Her phone was at home while she visited her grandmother.

items.hint: 问句不是事实；认清说话人，再核对while、before与will。

transfer.stem: Which summary keeps the stated reason and the promised return place?

NEW TRANSCRIPT PRACTICE — AUDIO PENDING
Jun: You did not answer my call yesterday. Were you avoiding me?
Rae: No. My phone was in my bag while I helped at the library. I noticed the missed call later. I will call you after dinner about our poster.
Jun: Thanks for explaining. Can I borrow your coloured pencils? I left mine at home.
Rae: Yes, but please return them before the art club starts. I need them for my drawing.
Jun: I will leave them on your shelf at the end of lunch.

options.text: Rae missed the call because her phone was in her bag; Jun will return Rae’s pencils to Rae’s shelf at the end of lunch.
Rae missed the call because she was avoiding Jun; Jun will return Rae’s pencils to Rae’s shelf at the end of lunch.

answer.display: Rae missed the call because her phone was in her bag; Jun will return Rae’s pencils to Rae’s shelf at the end of lunch.

explanation.strategy: 先用No后的解释核对原因，再把your接回正在听话的人。

steps.text: Rae否认躲着Jun；手机在包里，后来才看到未接来电。
steps.reason: Were you avoiding me是Jun的问题，不能当Rae已经承认的原因。

steps.text: Jun向Rae借彩铅；他说your shelf，所以承诺放到Rae的架子上。
steps.reason: mine是Jun忘在家的彩铅，your指Rae；归还是之后的承诺，不是已发生的记录。

distractors.reason: 归还地点和时间保留对了，却把Jun的疑问当成事实；Rae明确用No否认。
晚看到来电的原因对了，却把对Rae说的your shelf错接成Jun自己的架子。

explanation.pitfall: 听到问句别急着认定原因；同一个your要看是谁对谁说。
